description: Agent Claims: submit a denial letter with the policy and the claim record: the letter with its reference, the claim number and policy number it cites, the day sent, each ground for denial with its id, the ground as stated, each fact it relies on, the exclusion it cites and the exclusion wording it quotes, whether it states a right to appeal, the appeal period it states in days and the appeal deadline it states; the policy with its number, each exclusion with its reference and wording, and the days it allows to appeal a denial; the claim record with its claim number and each fact it establishes, such as the inspection findings, dates and statements on file. The signed report gives the letter, the policy and the claim record, each ground with the facts it relies on read against the facts on record, each exclusion cited found in the policy and its quote read against the policy’s wording, and the appeal right, period and deadline read against the policy, counted from the day the letter was sent, and counts them, and names a divergent letter: a ground the claim record does not support, an exclusion the policy does not hold, an exclusion quoted unlike the policy’s wording, an appeal period or deadline stated unlike the policy, and an appeal right or deadline left out of the letter; then a ground naming no fact and another claim or policy number, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No grounds, no facts on the claim record, no exclusions where the letter cites them, no quote, or no appeal period on the policy leaves those points unverified. Facts read by their words with plurals folded, a quote matches the policy’s wording or a run of its whole words in order, and the deadline counts in whole days. This reads the letter against the policy and the record as written. Verdict claims_denial_divergent, claims_denial_partial, claims_denial_unverified or claims_denial_consistent. POST /api/claims-denial-check. Reads the claim records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between claim documents only: it never files or submits a claim, never negotiates or pays one and never decides coverage, which stays with the insurer, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Claims reads claim records across the claim lifecycle for consistency between the claim documents and the policy they claim under: a first notice of loss, a sworn proof of loss, an adjuster’s report, a repair or replacement estimate, a settlement offer and release, a denial letter, a subrogation demand and a claim payment record, each against the policy, the first notice, the inspection record and claim file, the approved scope, the claim valuation, the claim record, the payment record or the settlement or adjudication it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral across property, casualty and liability claims and reads different claim documents against each other and against the policy. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-claims-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-claims/.
